title: A note at the model boat afternoon
passage:
For the distance board, mark where a boat first comes to rest. If it drifts again, that doesn’t change the mark. Adult help with making the boat is fine; use the shared column if the adult also releases it. Boats on that board cannot change sails after launch. Both tables have blank sheets. The thick entrance sheets split when folded. Noor used paper from the far stack. Both ends have viewing stripes.

Yesterday, Noor’s uncle helped fold her boat, then let go of one side as she freed the other. The boat stopped beside the yellow flag, then caught another breeze and reached green. The drying rack now blocks the far stripe’s view.

Today we’ll start behind the wind screen, then turn out into the open. The large sail moved well behind the screen but folded on the open side. The small one worked in the open at either height. Behind the screen it barely moved until we raised it on the taller mast.
passageZh:
若要把成績列入距離榜，請記紙船第一次停下的位置。後來再漂動，不會改變紀錄。大人幫忙做船沒問題；如果大人也一起放船，就記在共同下水欄。距離榜上的船下水後不能換帆。兩張桌上都有空白紙。入口旁的厚紙一摺就會裂開。努兒用的是遠端那疊紙。場地兩端都畫有觀賽線。

昨天努兒的叔叔幫她摺船，下水時他放開一側，她同時鬆開另一側。船在黃旗旁停下，後來又被一陣風帶到綠旗。如今晾乾架擋住了遠端觀賽線的視線。

今天從擋風板後出發，轉彎後進入沒有遮蔽的一側。大帆在擋風板後走得順，到了開放區卻折下來。小帆在開放區不論架高或放低都能用；在擋風板後，紙船原本幾乎不動；把小帆裝到較高的桅桿上後，紙船才航行起來。
